name: @qorpera/shell
description: Qorpera Base shell — the minimal desktop app every company controller is built on.

scripts.build: tsgo -p tsconfig.build.json && shx rm -rf dist/renderer && shx cp -r src/renderer dist/renderer && shx cp src/preload.cjs dist/preload.cjs && shx cp ../../node_modules/marked/lib/marked.umd.js dist/renderer/marked.umd.js
